risks.risk: Material may be steel rather than aluminum (affects weight and value).
risks.proof: A photo of any frame label/sticker/engraving that states aluminum, or a close-up of the frame with readable markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as steel-frame used bicycle.

risks.risk: Condition/rideability not confirmed (brakes, wheel alignment, drivetrain wear, tire condition).
risks.proof: Short video of a test ride and braking, plus close-ups of brake pads, chain condition, and tire tread.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at worst case: needs basic servicing (brakes/chain/tires) until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Possible missing parts or non-matching components (e.g., derailleur/shifters not original).
risks.proof: Photos of the full drivetrain from side (rear derailleur, cassette/freewheel, crankset) and both shifters.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified configuration; assume parts may need checking/replacement.

Photo of any frame markings/label that states aluminum (or a clear close-up of the frame for readable text).
Video test: ride forward, shift through gears, and demonstrate braking.
Close-ups of tires, brake pads, chain, and wheel hubs (to assess wear and alignment).
